info.title: Project Glasshaus API
info.description: REST API for Project Glasshaus. Every capability is also available as an MCP tool. Authenticate with `Authorization: Bearer <api token>` or the browser session cookies (unsafe methods then need the `X-CSRF-Token` header). Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

post.summary: Sign in with email and password (sets session cookies)
Rotate the session using the refresh cookie

patch.summary: Update a user's name, role or status

post.summary: Create an API token (the secret is returned once)

get.summary: Get a project by its key
Get a project with its statuses

delete.summary: Delete a project and its tasks (dry_run=true, the default, only previews)

put.summary: Add or change a project member

delete.summary: Delete a status, moving its tasks to replacement_status_id

schema.description: Tasks having all of these tags.

token.title: Token

affected.title: Affected

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page; null when done.

status_id.title: Status Id
status_id.description: Defaults to the project's first 'todo' status.
